verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is a single mention of 'Stripe Billing automations' that control customer communications. This suggests a first-party event-driven automation feature, but its rule-definition model, triggers, and actions are not documented. Webhooks and Smart Retries are a developer building block and a fixed built-in behavior, not user-defined rules, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented rule builder (conditions/triggers/actions), the range of supported events and actions, examples of defining automations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Automate many of your customer interactions by combining a customer portal with customer communications controlled by Stripe Billing automations.
